items.definition:
the bad guy in a story
The superhero always defeats the villain.

a narrow passageway
The cat ran down the dark alley.

a natural desire to satisfy a bodily need, especially for food
Exercise can increase your appetite.

a large outdoor board for displaying advertisements
We saw a huge billboard advertising a new car.

a person who uses strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker
The teacher told the bully to stop bothering the other students.

a person born in or coming from a foreign country
Many foreigners visit our city every year.

a person skilled in ninjutsu, a Japanese martial art
The children pretended to be ninjas.

the process of raising and educating a child
Good parenting involves patience and understanding.

waste material; trash
Please put the rubbish in the bin.

a place where people get their hair cut or styled, or other beauty treatments
She went to the salon to get a new haircut.

a fastener consisting of two rows of teeth on strips of fabric that are interlocked by a sliding tab
My jacket zip is broken.

an arrangement to reserve something
We have a booking for dinner at 7 PM.

a gentle wind
A cool breeze blew through the open window.

a public festival
The town hosts a carnival every summer.

a voucher entitling the holder to a discount
I used a coupon to get a discount on the groceries.

a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid
She kneaded the dough to make bread.

a book giving instructions or information
Please refer to the employee handbook for company policies.

a female domestic servant
The hotel maid cleaned our room every day.

a type of tree
Maple syrup comes from maple trees.

a small truck; the act of collecting something
We need to arrange for the pickup of the package.

an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to
The referee blew the whistle to end the game.

a roll of parchment or paper; a decorative design
She found an ancient scroll in the library.

the mass or line of foam formed by waves breaking on a seashore
We watched the surf crash against the rocks.

Uniform Resource Locator (web address)
Please type the URL into your browser.

money given regularly to a child or for a specific purpose
My parents gave me a weekly allowance.

the outer covering of a tree trunk; the sound a dog makes
The dog's loud bark startled the cat.

a person who writes for a blog
She is a popular fashion blogger.

a follower of Buddhism
He became a Buddhist after studying Eastern philosophy.

a wheeled vehicle, especially one pulled by horses or a part of a train
The royal family arrived in a horse-drawn carriage.

a person who writes music
Beethoven was a famous classical composer.

a simplified drawing showing the appearance, structure, or workings of something
The teacher drew a diagram to explain the process.

a person who explores an unfamiliar area
Christopher Columbus was a famous explorer.

the outer edge of a circular object
The rim of the glass was chipped.

a sound or mark made by something falling into or hitting liquid
We heard a big splash as he jumped into the pool.

a fictional character with superhuman powers
My favorite superhero is Spider-Man.

a notice or announcement promoting a product, service, or event
I saw an interesting advertisement for a new car.

a support projecting from a wall
He installed a new bracket to hold the shelf.

a female deer, especially a fallow deer or roe deer
We saw a doe and her fawn in the forest.

a jelly-like substance
She used hair gel to style her hair.

a harbor for pleasure boats
We walked along the marina at sunset.

routine administrative work involving documents
I have a lot of paperwork to finish today.

an act of spilling
Be careful not to cause a spill.

an area of low-lying uncultivated ground where water collects
Alligators live in the swamp.

clapping to show approval or enjoyment
The audience erupted in thunderous applause.

a device containing combustible chemicals that is ignited to produce colored lights, smoke, and noise
The firework display on New Year's Eve was spectacular.

the state of being humid; a moderate amount of wetness in the air
The high humidity made the summer day feel even hotter.

the quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech
His dry humour always makes me laugh.

state of being innocent
Her innocence was clear to everyone.

a climbing plant
The old house was covered in ivy.

farm animals
The farmer raised various types of livestock.

a large wild cat
A black panther was spotted in the jungle.

a ridge of rock, sand, or coral near the surface of the sea
We went snorkeling near the coral reef.

the act of refusing
His refusal to cooperate caused problems.

an extremely famous and successful person
She became a global superstar overnight.

a member of the Scandinavian seafaring pirates and traders who raided and settled in many parts of northwestern Europe in the 8th–11th centuries.
The Vikings were skilled navigators.

a clear alcoholic spirit
He ordered a glass of vodka.

a chemical element essential for bones and teeth
Milk is a good source of calcium.

a slow, continuous movement
We noticed a snow drift against the fence.

a substance used to change the color of something
She used a natural dye to color the fabric.

a person who teaches or educates
She is a dedicated educator who cares deeply about her students.

an opening in a floor, wall, or roof
The crew opened the escape hatch.

a delicate fabric; a cord used for fastening
She wore a dress with delicate lace trim.

an open public space where a market is held
Farmers sell their produce at the local marketplace.

something offered
They brought an offering to the temple.
